title: 跨区域策略窗口审计
description: policy.resolve_window 在临界上界错误地拒绝请求。仓库迁移留下了 24 份按区域拆分的契约文档 contracts/region_01.md 到 contracts/region_24.md；这些文档共同定义兼容性要求，不能只依据公开测试。请先逐份完整读取全部 24 份契约；为避免一次混合过多区域证据，每轮最多读取 4 份，分批完成审计。确认共同边界语义后，再定位实现、做最小修复、运行 pytest，并检查最终 Diff。

generated_text_series.line_template: Audit clause {line} for region {index02}: preserve inclusive customer-visible boundaries, deterministic decisions, existing return types, and backward-compatible behavior across migrated policy data.
generated_text_series.footer_template: Decision note for region {index02}: a value equal to the configured upper boundary remains inside the accepted window; values greater than it are outside.
